<div style="width:100%;height:720px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:24px 52px;background:#ffffff;color:#1f2937;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;overflow:hidden;">

  </div>

  <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:30px;flex:1;">

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:16px 12px 0 12px;">

      <div style="display:grid;gap:13px;font-size:18.4px;line-height:1.28;color:#344054;">
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Held-out test set:</strong> final model performance was checked on unseen data.</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Same split:</strong> all models used the same train-test split for fair comparison.</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">3-class target:</strong> we predicted Dissatisfied, Neutral, and Satisfied.</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Class-level check:</strong> we checked whether each class was actually recognised.</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;align-content:start;padding-top:0;">

      <div style="background:#f8fbff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;border-radius:12px;padding:16px 14px;box-sizing:border-box;">
        <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Accuracy</div>
        <div style="font-size:16px;line-height:1.26;color:#344054;">Overall correct prediction rate</div>
      </div>

      <div style="background:#315f9f;border:1px solid #254d85;border-radius:12px;padding:16px 14px;box-sizing:border-box;">
        <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:760;color:#ffffff;margin-bottom:6px;">Macro F1 ★</div>
        <div style="font-size:16px;line-height:1.26;color:#d6e4fb;">Primary metric — treats all classes equally</div>
      </div>

      <div style="background:#f8fbff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;border-radius:12px;padding:16px 14px;box-sizing:border-box;">
        <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Kappa</div>
        <div style="font-size:16px;line-height:1.26;color:#344054;">Agreement beyond random chance</div>
      </div>

      <div style="background:#f8fbff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;border-radius:12px;padding:16px 14px;box-sizing:border-box;">
        <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Recall</div>
        <div style="font-size:16px;line-height:1.26;color:#344054;">Shows which classes are missed</div>
      </div>

    </div>

  </div>

</div>
